create_budget_for_user: create a daily budget for a user using BudgetManager with a total amount and duration
check_user_budget_before_call: check if a user has remaining budget before making an LLM completion call
update_cost_after_completion: update the cost for a user after an LLM completion using the response object
save_budget_data_to_client: save all budget data to the hosted client using the save_data method
reset_expired_budgets: reset expired user budgets by calling update_budget_all_users after duration has passed
